recommendation.reason: Agentic terminal benchmark with expert-authored, reviewed tasks, oracle validation and strong attention; no blocking rule fires.
risks: Reward hacking and shortcuts are not discussed.
No repeated-run variance or confidence intervals reported.
Best score is unknown, so saturation cannot be checked.

release.quote: === github: harbor-framework/terminal-bench (commit/revision bdf60347ddb22be127cf3af14215c0385ea08705, licence field: Apache-2.0) ===

redistribution_questions: Whether Apache-2.0 covers the task data as well as any third-party Docker images.

verifier.quote: Download both prompt files (docs/prompts/task-implementation.toml and docs/prompts/trial-analysis.toml), the /run and /cheat trial artifacts, and the task files (instruction.md, task.toml, environment/, solution/, tests/).

oracle.command:
uv tool install 'harbor[modal]'
uv run harbor run -d terminal-bench/terminal-bench@latest -k 5 --agent oracle --n-concurrent 500 --env modal
oracle.quote: Install [Harbor](https://harborframework.com/docs) and run the oracle solutions 5x to confirm all tasks work as expected in your the sandboxing environment.

network_or_api: internet access (allow_internet = true in legacy tasks)
exceptions: Tasks with [verifier] environment_mode = "separate", such as tasks/cad-model/task.toml and tasks/wdm-design/task.toml.
legacy/mailman/task.toml needs postfix and mailman3 configuration.
runtime.quote:
docker_image = "alexgshaw/fix-git:20260403"
cpus = 1
memory_mb = 2048
storage_mb = 10240
gpus = 0
allow_internet = true
mcp_servers = []
